name: slopfreedotwork
description: The home for slop free jobs.
author: snegs

scripts.patch:workerd: GLIBC=$(guix build glibc | grep -v debug | grep -v static | head -n 1); GCC=$(guix build gcc-toolchain | grep -v debug | grep -v static | head -n 1); patchelf --set-interpreter "$GLIBC/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" --set-rpath "$GLIBC/lib:$GCC/lib" node_modules/@cloudflare/workerd-linux-64/bin/workerd || true
scripts.patch:biome: GLIBC=$(guix build glibc | grep -v debug | grep -v static | head -n 1); GCC=$(guix build gcc-toolchain | grep -v debug | grep -v static | head -n 1); patchelf --set-interpreter "$GLIBC/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2" --set-rpath "$GLIBC/lib:$GCC/lib" node_modules/@biomejs/cli-linux-x64/biome || true
scripts.postinstall: npm run patch:workerd && npm run patch:biome
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
